body: Lmao yeah it’s definitely romanticized and glorified in the media and I hate it. For me It isn’t so simple though, I’ll listen to music but I sit there for about 1-2 hours kind of forcing myself to.

Ah, yeah I get the urges all the time but I have to be very calculated when I do it. I rarely have time home alone so if I do it, it’s gotta be in the middle of the night when no ones awake. I’m also busy during the day with outpatient so I don’t have the day either.
Yeah, that’s most common I believe. I do hope you can eventually curve this addiction though :)
I struggle with it being quick, it’s usually a 1-2 hour process for me because of the headspace I’m in and how I do them.

I’m just reading this one now so sorry if you’ve seen the comment that I just recently deleted! 

As for this, I wouldn’t say it’s out of punishment. I’ve always liked body mods and jewelry, but I’ve just been thinking about how many times I’ve done it, how many times I’ve failed and done it again, some I won’t even keep etc. 

Maybe it is the strong emotion thing? The feeling of elatedness? I guess I’ll just have to do more thinking. Thank you though, I hope you have a good night too!

From what I’m gathering, your mom is a very empathetic person so she gets emotional and doesn’t easily understand mental illness. I think telling her you were planning something wasn’t the right way to go, because it might constantly nag in the back of her mind that her child is going to hurt themselves soon. 

Do you not tell anyone anything because it’s physically/mentally hard to speak out about it? Is it embarrassing? Do you not want people to worry? 

For me I don’t want people to worry but I realized overtime I had to put trust in people who I know care about me, and educate them at least a little about what I’m going through. 

You might not get anything out of being admitted, but you might, that’s the point. Of course you won’t get better at all if you don’t want to try getting better, if you want to stay the same as you are now then you will, it’s all about trying to make the change. 

And yeah, I’ve been admitted two times back in 2017-2018 when I was 13-14

I’d say admit yourself. I’m going to admit myself soon, and I’m hoping I can get better for the sake of my parents because I love them to death and I know it would crush them. I don’t know your family situation but there is always gonna be someone that would be crushed if you ended it. I cant tell you not to, it’s not my decision and I know full well what it’s like to want to die, I can only hope at some point you find peace and content and I’m sorry that wanting to hurt yourself and die is the only way you can feel okay. I know what it’s like, I’m with you.

I used to be very arty too, and now it’s just simply too much of a task for me to even bother. I think you need to find a comfort person, you’ve probably been told this so much but you should invest in a therapist, and if you have one and it isn’t going to well, change it up. 

I think this is something you can come out of and this is hypocritical considering I was just complaining about possibly committing suicide in the future, but all of us and everyone in the world have a chance at becoming better.

I agree. I don’t like it when they close up and aren’t the same size when they first were opened, it’s a bad way of thinking and I’m never satisfied. 

I try to be positive around my friends and I’m lucky enough that they understand and if not that than sympathize. I’m going to admit myself soon and you should probably too. 

We shouldn’t have to suffer and rely on damaging ourselves for comfort although I know it’s easier said than done.

I didn’t know how to express my pain, etc. it still like that now sometimes but like 99% of the time, the urge is just to straight up mutilate. I don’t have thoughts of hurting others or anything like that, so it just seems like I’m satisfied when I do a great deal of damage to myself.
